topic: Your Phone's Battery Learns Your Habits
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know your phone's battery is secretly a smart student 🤓?

💡 Your phone's battery learns your habits to optimize charging. It avoids staying at 100% too long, extending its lifespan. Like preparing ahead!
